svg.title: Chisum: DC2 24 V DC panel, radio, JS8-864 sheet 4 revision 0
svg.text: JS8-864 sheet 4 · 24 V direct current · Wheelhouse · register component ELD-04 · fed from DCB-R (24 v dc board, radio bank)
The radio installation on its own battery (the reserve source of energy): both VHF sets, the NAVTEX receiver, the position fix for the distress call, the portable sets' charger.
FRONT, DOOR OPEN (1 : 4.2 on a 96 dpi screen; the cabinet is 520 × 493 × 210 mm)
X1: terminals 1 to 12 on the lower rail, an earth terminal (green) after each pair.
Gland plate: one gland a cable, in the order of the terminals. PE: the earth bar.
from DCB-R: feeder to 24 v dc panel, radio
VHF No. 1: COM-01 VHF radiotelephone No. 1, with DSC
VHF No. 2: COM-02 VHF radiotelephone No. 2
GPS navigator, second supply: NAV-06 GPS navigator
Portable VHF charger: COM-06 Portable VHF sets and charger

m: the cable's length with its branches and a tenth for bends and making off. Drop: from the switchboard to the farthest consumer. Earth cores go to the terminal after each pair, and from there to the PE bar.
Wall cabinet, sheet steel, 520 mm wide, 210 mm deep, door with a lock, IP44, with mounting plate and gland plate
Switch-disconnector, two-pole, 25 A, 24 V DC, for the incoming feeder
Indicator lamp, supply on, 24 V DC, one for each feeder
Miniature circuit breaker, two-pole, 2 A, for direct current, 24 V
Miniature circuit breaker, two-pole, 10 A, for direct current, 24 V
Earth terminal, green and yellow, on the rail
End stop and end plate for the terminal row
Cable gland, brass, nickel-plated, M20, with locknut and seal
Cable gland, brass, nickel-plated, M25, with locknut and seal
Cable gland, brass, nickel-plated, M40, with locknut and seal
Slotted wiring duct, 40 × 60 mm, with cover
Comb busbar, two-pole, for the row of breakers
Earth bar, copper, with a bolt to the cabinet and to the door
Label, engraved: one for the board, one for each way and each feeder
Circuit list, in a pocket inside the door

The board's contents are the register's: one way for each circuit, each breaker and cable as the register sized them. The cabinet, the devices' form, the terminals and the glands are the yard's own choice (electrical_drawing.py, HARDWARE) and no maker is named.

Both poles of every way are switched and protected: the system is two-wire and insulated from the hull, so a breaker in one pole would leave the other alive. An earth-fault lamp set belongs on the switchboard that feeds the board, not here.

Standards a builder would work to, as the yard recalls them (not read for this sheet): IEC 60092 (electrical installations in ships), IEC 61439 (low-voltage assemblies), IEC 60898-1 and IEC 60947-2 (breakers).
Made by ferry/yard/drawings/electrical_drawing.py from ferry/data/systems.json (the component register). The model's cabinet is to be built from this sheet: an incomer, a breaker for each way, the
